title: Listening Drill — Plant exchange project
description: Project planning dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Plant exchange project
sections.transcript:
COORDINATOR: Thanks for joining this planning meeting about a plant exchange. The progress report is due on Tuesday. We need to agree what can be ready before then.

MEMBER: I'll start by checking the sign-up sheet. That should tell us whether the previous team has already solved part of the problem.

COORDINATOR: Good. For the trial we will use the seed table. Send your results to Tess first, not to the whole group. I don't want unconfirmed figures copied into the report.

MEMBER: Understood. We should also remember that walk-in visitors may have different needs. I'll make a note of that in the schedule.
